using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Akiiray.VRCAvatarLiteKitPlus;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using VRC.SDK3.Avatars.Components;
using VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

public sealed class LiteKitInspectorCheck : EditorWindow
{
    private const string LongName = "SYNC_This_is_a_deliberately_long_parameter_name_to_verify_that_the_checkbox_remains_visible";
    private const string LanguageKey = "Akiiray.VRCAvatarLiteKitPlus.Language";
    private Editor inspector;
    private Vector2 scroll;
    private string oldLanguage;
    private bool languageWasSet;
    private int renderStep = -1;
    private bool advanceQueued;

    // Use -executeMethod LiteKitInspectorCheck.ShowFixture in a disposable Unity project.
    public static void ShowFixture()
    {
        RunChecks();
        var window = GetWindow<LiteKitInspectorCheck>(true, "LiteKit Inspector Fixture");
        window.position = new Rect(100, 100, 680, 740);
        window.languageWasSet = EditorPrefs.HasKey(LanguageKey);
        window.oldLanguage = EditorPrefs.GetString(LanguageKey);
        EditorPrefs.SetString(LanguageKey, "Japanese");
        window.inspector = Editor.CreateEditor(CreateFixture());
        window.Show();
        window.renderStep = 0;
    }

    private void OnGUI()
    {
        using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
        {
            if (GUILayout.Button("日本語")) EditorPrefs.SetString(LanguageKey, "Japanese");
            if (GUILayout.Button("English")) EditorPrefs.SetString(LanguageKey, "English");
        }
        using (var view = new EditorGUILayout.ScrollViewScope(scroll))
        {
            scroll = view.scrollPosition;
            if (inspector != null)
            {
                inspector.OnInspectorGUI();
                if (Event.current.type == EventType.Repaint && renderStep >= 0 && !advanceQueued)
                {
                    advanceQueued = true;
                    EditorApplication.delayCall += AdvanceRendering;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void AdvanceRendering()
    {
        if (!this || inspector == null) return;
        var filter = inspector.GetType().GetField("parameterFilter", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        Debug.Log($"LITEKIT_INSPECTOR_DRAW {EditorPrefs.GetString(LanguageKey)} / {filter.GetValue(inspector)}");
        advanceQueued = false;
        renderStep++;
        if (renderStep == 6)
        {
            renderStep = -1;
            Debug.Log("LITEKIT_INSPECTOR_DRAW_PASS 6");
            return;
        }
        EditorPrefs.SetString(LanguageKey, renderStep < 3 ? "Japanese" : "English");
        filter.SetValue(inspector, Enum.ToObject(filter.FieldType, renderStep % 3));
        Repaint();
    }

    private void OnDestroy()
    {
        if (languageWasSet) EditorPrefs.SetString(LanguageKey, oldLanguage);
        else if (oldLanguage != null) EditorPrefs.DeleteKey(LanguageKey);
    }

    private static LiteKitParameterCompressor CreateFixture()
    {
        var avatar = new GameObject("Inspector Fixture");
        var component = avatar.AddComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>();
        var descriptor = avatar.GetComponent<VRCAvatarDescriptor>();
        var expression = CreateInstance<VRCExpressionParameters>();
        expression.parameters = new[]
        {
            Parameter("SYNC_EMOTE", VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType.Int),
            Parameter(LongName, VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType.Int),
            Parameter("SYNC_HANDSIGN", VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType.Int),
            Parameter("Viseme", VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType.Float),
            Parameter("FlapOn", VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType.Bool)
        };
        descriptor.expressionParameters = expression;
        var fx = new AnimatorController { name = "Fixture FX" };
        fx.AddParameter("FX_Trigger", AnimatorControllerParameterType.Trigger);
        descriptor.baseAnimationLayers = new[]
        {
            new VRCAvatarDescriptor.CustomAnimLayer
            {
                type = VRCAvatarDescriptor.AnimLayerType.FX, animatorController = fx
            }
        };
        component.ExcludedParameters.Add("SYNC_HANDSIGN");
        component.ExcludedParameters.Add("FlapOn");
        return component;
    }

    private static VRCExpressionParameters.Parameter Parameter(string name, VRCExpressionParameters.ValueType type) =>
        new VRCExpressionParameters.Parameter { name = name, valueType = type, networkSynced = true };

    public static void RunChecks()
    {
        var component = CreateFixture();
        var editor = Editor.CreateEditor(component);
        try
        {
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "SYNC_HANDSIGN", "FlapOn"), "Initial settings");
            Assert(Count(editor, "Configurable") == 3, "Configurable includes only editable rows");
            Assert(Count(editor, "All") == 6, "All rows including FX");
            Assert(Count(editor, "ExcludedOnly") == 4, "Excluded includes manual and automatic rows");
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "SYNC_HANDSIGN", "FlapOn"), "Filters are read-only");
            Assert(PlanTargets(editor, component) == 2, "Initial preview targets");

            Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();
            SetExcluded(editor, "SYNC_HANDSIGN", false);
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "FlapOn") && PlanTargets(editor, component) == 3, "ON restores the target");
            Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();
            Undo.PerformUndo();
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "SYNC_HANDSIGN", "FlapOn") && PlanTargets(editor, component) == 2, "Undo");
            Undo.PerformRedo();
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "FlapOn") && PlanTargets(editor, component) == 3, "Redo");

            component.EnableCompression = false;
            SetExcluded(editor, LongName, true);
            Assert(ContainsOnly(component, "FlapOn", LongName) && PlanTargets(editor, component) == 2, "OFF while globally disabled");
            var path = AssetDatabase.GenerateUniqueAssetPath("Assets/LiteKitInspectorFixture.prefab");
            var prefab = PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(component.gameObject, path);
            Assert(prefab != null, "Prefab saved");
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(path, ImportAssetOptions.ForceUpdate);
            var instance = (GameObject)PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab(AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(path));
            var loaded = instance.GetComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>();
            var reopened = Editor.CreateEditor(loaded);
            try
            {
                Assert(!loaded.EnableCompression && ContainsOnly(loaded, "FlapOn", LongName), "Prefab reload and inspector reopen");
                SetExcluded(reopened, LongName, false);
                Assert(ContainsOnly(loaded, "FlapOn") && PrefabUtility.HasPrefabInstanceAnyOverrides(instance, false), "Prefab override");
                Assert(ContainsOnly(prefab.GetComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>(), "FlapOn", LongName), "Prefab asset unchanged");
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(reopened);
                Object.DestroyImmediate(instance);
            }
            Debug.Log("LITEKIT_INSPECTOR_PASS");
        }
        finally
        {
            Object.DestroyImmediate(editor);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(component.gameObject);
        }
    }

    private static bool ContainsOnly(LiteKitParameterCompressor component, params string[] names) =>
        new HashSet<string>(component.ExcludedParameters).SetEquals(names) && component.ExcludedParameters.Count == names.Length;

    private static System.Collections.IEnumerable Scanned(Editor editor) =>
        (System.Collections.IEnumerable)editor.GetType().GetField("scanned", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(editor);

    private static int Count(Editor editor, string filter)
    {
        var type = editor.GetType();
        var match = type.GetMethod("MatchesFilter", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
        var filterValue = Enum.Parse(type.GetNestedType("ParameterFilter", BindingFlags.NonPublic), filter);
        var find = type.Assembly.GetType(type.Namespace + ".ParameterExclusionRules").GetMethod("GetExclusion", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
        var names = ((LiteKitParameterCompressor)editor.target).ExcludedParameters;
        return Scanned(editor).Cast<object>().Count(p => (bool)match.Invoke(null, new[] { filterValue, find.Invoke(null, new object[] { p, names }) }));
    }

    private static int PlanTargets(Editor editor, LiteKitParameterCompressor component)
    {
        var type = editor.GetType();
        var create = type.Assembly.GetType(type.Namespace + ".CompressionPlan").GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);
        var plan = create.Invoke(null, new object[] { Scanned(editor), component.ExcludedParameters, 1 });
        return ((System.Collections.ICollection)plan.GetType().GetField("Targets", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(plan)).Count;
    }

    private static void SetExcluded(Editor editor, string name, bool excluded)
    {
        editor.serializedObject.Update();
        editor.GetType().GetMethod("SetExcluded", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).Invoke(editor, new object[] { name, excluded });
    }

    private static void Assert(bool ok, string message)
    {
        if (!ok) throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }
}
